name: Turret
description: Blocking places a turret with its own shield bubble.
details: Blocking also places a turret just ahead of you (between you and any wall you drop). The turret has its own block bubble: its health grows with Block duration and Block size, it breaks and recharges in 3 s, and an intact bubble slowly refills. The bubble turns redder as it nears breaking. Turret health, lifetime, shots and damage grow with your block stats: Block size, Block duration, Echo blocks (= shots per volley), Bullets on block and Reflected damage. Echo blocks are spaced 5 s apart.
